title: Neuromatch Academy: Deep Learning (course ebook)
authors: Neuromatch Academy (course content team; per-tutorial content creators are named on each tutorial page)
description: Three-week intensive deep learning course published as a Jupyter Book: per-day chapters (W1D1–W3D5) each with one to three tutorials mixing short videos, text, coding exercises, interactive demos and discussion prompts; a prerequisites page; a daily schedule; project booklets. Content is CC BY 4.0, software BSD-3-Clause.
rightsNotes: Content licence (verified on the ebook footer and in the repository README on 2026-10-30): 'The contents of this repository are shared under under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.' Attribution is required; commercial use and derivatives are permitted.
Code licence is separate: 'Software elements are additionally licensed under the BSD (3-Clause) License.' LICENSE-CODE.md is a BSD 3-Clause licence, copyright 2020 Neuromatch Academy.

Corniversity cites tutorial pages by URL and section anchor, writes its own lessons and original exercises, and does not redistribute Neuromatch notebooks. Any exercise adapted from a Neuromatch coding exercise must be labelled adapted_with_attribution.

The ebook is a rolling publication ('under continuous development' per the repository README); pages carry 'Last updated on None', so there is no per-page version stamp. Locators are pinned to the titles and section ids seen on 2026-10-30.

Embedded lecture videos were not watched; no video locators are recorded. Tutorials are cited by page and section anchor.

The Neuromatch schedule is a three-week intensive; it is not an evening-study workload estimate. Corniversity re-paces the material.
The ebook offers Colab and Kaggle launch buttons; running notebooks requires those third-party services or a local PyTorch installation, which Corniversity does not provide.
